subtitleNullable: Large scale image dataset of ancient Greek characters on papyrus
descriptionNullable: AL-PUB_v2 contains 205,797 tightly cropped images of characters from ancient Greek Papyri. The dataset was developed using volunteer crowdsourced annotations of 12,070 manuscript fragments from the Oxyrhynchus Papyri collection. The annotations are a product of the Ancient Lives Project and include samples from all 24 characters in the standard Greek alphabet with one notable exception: Lunate Sigma. The form of Sigma most widely recognized in the Western world (Σ) is typically supplanted by the Lunate Sigma (Ϲ) on papyrus. In our samples there are 37 images of Σ and 10,151 images of Ϲ. It thus makes a great deal of sense to update our dataset with the Ϲ replacing the small sample of Σ. Both versions of the dataset are available for download below. AL-PUB & AL-PUB_v2 are subsets of the currently unpublished AL-ALL Dataset. Roughly half of AL-ALL are from currently unpublished manuscripts and due to image rights and ongoing papyrological research cannot be made publicly available at this time. Both datasets were developed with machine learning and optical character recognition in mind and we hope the dataset will be a valuable alternative to other large scale machine learning, character image datasets, especially for digital humanities research. This project is a collaboration of Middle Tennessee State University, The University of Tennessee, The University of Kentucky, and The University of Minnesota. The dataset was introduce in the proceeding of the 2021 IEEE eScience conference in our paper, "Exploring Learning Approaches for Ancient Greek Character Recognition with Citizen Science Data" available at https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/9582410
